source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: D231154 asks for an at-a-glance method summary followed by a separate paragraph explaining when an external consumer calls it. The actual historical header and fixed Exchange header keep OnCopyCompleted summary separate from the condition that a consumer cannot or should not start the operation; the paragraph names global-copy-service dequeue. Method references use parentheses in the sequence description. This is scoped manual documentation guidance for these methods, not fixed blank-line counts. The review explicitly leaves API-versus-design document placement unresolved and calls /** convention less established in C++.
title: Put copy completion consumer conditions after its short summary
